correctness.rationale: For the unique automorphism-invariant even theta characteristic of the Klein quartic, the cited primary Theorem 5.4 supplies 24 unlabelled heptagons constituting one PSL(2,7) orbit with heptagon stabilizer a cyclic H of order 7. The pinned program reconstructs points R_i=[b(a zeta^i)^3:a zeta^i:1] in K(a), K=Q(zeta_7), a^7=-(b+1)/b^3, seven sides and 14 residual quartic intersections, then closes projective automorphism matrices to |G|=168, tests a constituent-line stabilizer exactly as {id}, and gets 24 cosets. Critical claim can also be checked structurally: cross-product line coordinates L_0 are proportional over K to (c0,c2 a^2,c3 a^3), all c_i nonzero in K. Since T^7-const is irreducible over K, 1,a^2,a^3,a^4,a^5,a^6 are K-independent. If any K-matrix fixes this line projectively, eliminating its eigenvalue from second/third coordinate equations forces all off-diagonal entries zero and diagonal entries equal; it is projectively identity. Thus ANY subgroup of PGL3(K), including G, acts freely on L0; seven sides form H-orbit and distinct H-cosets are disjoint. Sympy independent irreducibility factorization of the degree-seven polynomial confirmed. General 168-line count relies on exact source group order, not float sampling.
